rationale:
Reusing the accepted frozen .075/.15 selection; no handoff restart.

ACCURACY (kept separate from economics). Four distinct local intervals were resolved: shared_first [0,0.01], early075 [0.01,0.02], and the two holding probes holding075/holding15 at [0.3,0.31]. Direction was resolved and correct 4/4 and all implicit-Radau resolution checks passed, but quantitative local accuracy fails at the declared tolerances: position 0/4, velocity-vector 0/4, speed 1/4 (only early075). Position errors of 1.6e-5–6.2e-5 m and vector errors of ~3–5e-3 m/s exceed the 1e-5 residual and 1e-4 vector tolerances; holding075 also shows a holding false-safe (observed hold speed 0.02329 m/s above the 0.02 limit while the predictor reported safe). Direction correctness is not physical accuracy and cannot be reported as such.

METHOD. The changed model is a 24-dimensional reduced serial virtual-work pullback (mass ~8%, gravity/bias ~5.4% differences from the reduced map). Continuous and represented-serial maps were each two-successive compared and pass, and localization is consistent; the discarded serial modes remain excluded, and the old continuum reference is explicitly not a reference for the changed mechanics, so no physical-accuracy transfer is claimed.

COST. The measured seven-replan approximation targets the dominant cost (665.7 s of a 694.4 s baseline pair). Its first command matches production, but later frozen commands diverge (probe error norm 3.32 N by t=0.02 s), so it is not exact production control. Forecast receipts are ~220.5 s/pair against complete evaluations of 303.8/302.1 s. The 83.3 s counterfactual net is nominal only: actual avoided evaluations and actual validation savings are both 0, and the receipt is a lower bound before the model-call overhead this export adds. Lower forecast runtime proves no saving.

SCREENING. Both complete, independent own-history forecasts resolved: predicted order history15<history075 matches observed, accuracy among resolved 1.0, coverage 1.0, no false rejection. But eligibility accuracy is 0.5 (history15 predicted violating though actually acceptable), and the holding false-safe stands. One pair with zero validated savings supports no generalization.

READINESS. NO_GO. The frozen admission gates are not met: quantitative local position/speed/vector accuracy fails and an unacceptable holding false-safe remains, which withholds safety/eligibility authority and cannot erase failed original accuracy; operational economics are unvalidated (actual avoided evaluations 0). The prerequisite numerical-stability, false-safe and validated-saving gates precede any experiment, so neither full nor ranking-only validation is admissible yet.

Supported diagnostic uses: direction sign across the four local intervals, numerical resolution self-consistency of the changed model, and one historical pairwise order. Screening is experimental only and deferred for any safety/eligibility use; complete evaluation is required whenever a decision would certify or gate a real execution. Another experiment is not justified under frozen conditions. Original M5 unmet: local quantitative position/speed/vector accuracy, no false-safe holding, validated savings, multi-pair prospective discrimination, broader repeatability, and real-time operation (35/35 deadlines missed).
readiness: NO_GO. Frozen numerical-stability, false-safe and validated-saving gates precede any experiment, so GO_EXPERIMENT_FULL and GO_EXPERIMENT_RANKING_ONLY are both premature.
